content: Build a regression pipeline to predict next-month revenue from account activity and historical invoices.
I normalized this as RevenueTrainingRequest to ModelRegistrationPacket and found template regression_train_evaluate_register.
CandidateBundle: load, validate, feature, split, train, evaluate, register. The validation gate includes schema and no-leakage checks.
A normal agent might build a notebook and accidentally include future cancellation_date or target labels. I will use deterministic feature validation and artifact-backed datasets instead.
Compiler rejects validate_schema_only because it lacks no_leakage_check, injects deterministic seed into the split, and blocks model registration until the metric gate passes.
Runtime stores dataset, feature table, model, and eval report as ArtifactRefs and records replayable JSONL events.
